saveLocal: This project is stored only in this browser
lookStripHint: Tap a look to change the finished video. Script and sound stay put.
browseLooksHint: Open the full library, including looks saved on this device
replaceLookMessage: This replaces caption appearance and the canvas background. Script, sound and timing stay unchanged and can be undone.
briefTitle: What would you like to talk about?
briefHint: Start with an idea, a script or your media. Choose a look or let AI arrange it.
adjustTitle: What would you like to change?
adjustHint: Your script and sound stay unchanged by default. Describe the adjustment you need.
inputPlaceholder: What you will say, who it is for, and how it should look. You can also paste a complete script.
adjustPlaceholder: For example: Keep the script and sound, use fewer title shots and a calmer look.
contextPlaceholder: What is your industry or topic? A sentence is enough.
contextHint: Share your industry or topic so the suggestions can be specific.
inspirationHint: Write a topic or paste a script first
makeUnavailable: Add an idea, a script or original sound before creating
rebuildHint: Rearranging respects protected groups. It does not regenerate audio.
paidHint: AI charges are settled by the server. New voice generation needs separate confirmation.
demoHint: Demo mode uses local examples, with no paid AI or voice calls.
scriptRewrite: Allow AI to improve the script
addPersonHint: Optional. Skip for a text-only talking video
coverHint: The cover is a separate 1:1 image, not a still placed on the video track.
preserveHint: Manual adjustments are protected. Explicitly uncheck a group to let AI change it.
useDigital: Use a completed digital human video
voiceMismatch: The script changed; sound is still the previous version.
needsTranscript: Original sound is kept. Add a script or SRT for captions; automatic transcription is not available.
audioRunning: Speech is processing in the background. Timing will follow its actual duration.
textOnly: Text-only video. Add a photo or video in Visuals & media if needed.
styleSaved: Look saved as a local template
creationProgress: Preview when ready. You may leave this page, but keep the browser running.
stagePaused: Pause, then select text or a person to adjust
advancedSettingsHint: Advanced preferences only affect the next AI run. Format lives in step 2 and voice in step 3.
advancedLookHint: Leave it to AI or lock a specific caption look for the next run.
stepContentHint: Say what this video is about, or paste a full script.
stepVisualHint: Confirm the format and finished look before continuing.
stepVoiceHint: Pick a voice, import audio, or explicitly skip and add sound later.
stepGenerateHint: Confirm the setup and generate the first version. Demo mode does not call paid AI.
stepGenerateAdjustHint: Keep the current visuals and voice; only change what you write.
stepEditHint: Click a caption or person on the canvas, then use the right tabs for captions, media, and shots.
stepExportHint: Choose cover ratio and source, then render the video.
scriptLaterHint: A full script is written when you tap Make; you can also paste a verbatim script in advanced settings.
openAdvancedScript: Add the full script in advanced settings
needContent: Write at least 10 characters, paste a script, or tap Help me find a direction on the right
needVisualConfirm: Confirm format and look before continuing
needVoiceChoice: Pick a voice, import audio, or tap Skip voice for now
voiceSkipHint: You can make a silent cut first and add sound later.
voiceChooseHint: Pick a voice to generate, or import existing audio.
formatHint: This only sets the video format; cover ratio is chosen in the last step.
legacyCoverNotice: This project still uses the legacy 3:4 cover format.
lookLocksHint: Choosing a look locks the caption appearance, so AI will not replace it next run.
aiImageHint: Use the existing image model to create a person or background, then add it to the canvas.
voiceKeepHint: The current audio stays until you replace it.
voiceOptionalHint: Choose a voice or import audio when you need sound.
voiceEmptyHint: Reload the voice list or import existing audio.
voiceNextHint: Confirm a voice or skip before generating.
coverIndependentHint: The cover is a separate image and does not change the video format.
coverPreviewHint: Preview uses the current title and photo; download is the last generated image, so regenerate after changes.
coverAiPlaceholder: e.g. bold title on a warm gradient, clean layout for Xiaohongshu
coverAiHint: Uses the connected image API; the server bills the request. Failures show the real error.
coverUploadHint: Use the whole image as the cover without poster type overlay.
resizeDivider: Drag to resize preview and editor
aiImagePromptPlaceholder: Describe the person or background, e.g. a half-body presenter on a clean light-grey background, front-facing, neutral expression
aiImagePaidHint: This calls the connected image generation API. The server bills the request; the result is added to the canvas as an asset and does not replace existing video automatically.
aiImageAddFailed: The image was generated but could not be added. Check the asset and try again.
resizeInspector: Drag to resize canvas and inspector
